name: Sensor Hoof Boot
short: Protective boot with a pressure-map insert for daily work and rehab.
problem: A hoof is not a flat surface. Uneven load is hard to see until lameness shows.
audience: Riders, vets and farriers who want a clear load picture, not a guess.
benefits: Replaceable sensor insert for load notes
faq: Does this replace a farrier?
No. It is a support product. A farrier still owns the trim.
Is the sensor medical advice?
No. It is a training aid for notes you already take.

name: Load Map Pad
short: Thin pad that records a simple left/right load sketch after each session.
problem: Session notes are often only ‘felt a bit off’ with no picture.
audience: Trainers who want a repeatable note, not a lab.
benefits: One pad, one session, one sketch
faq: Do I need an app store login?
No. Export is a local CSV file.
Works with metal shoes?
Yes, as a pad under the boot or on a mat.

name: Daily Hoof Kit
short: Pick, brush and moisture balm in one kit for a two-minute stall routine.
problem: Care products pile up and the routine dies after a week.
audience: Owners who want one kit, one place, every day.
benefits: Refill balm without buying a new kit
faq: Is the balm for thrush treatment?
No. It is daily moisture care, not a medicine.
Can I buy refill only?
Yes. The kit page links the refill.

name: Trim Note Cards
short: Waterproof cards so farrier and owner write the same three numbers after a trim.
problem: Handover is verbal and gone by next week.
audience: Yards that want a shared note, not a new software login.
benefits: Three fields only: angle, length, comment
Works with a pencil in the aisle
faq: Is this an app?
No. Paper on purpose. Fast in the barn.
Can I print more?
A PDF refill is on the product page.

name: Arena Study Bundle
short: Short brief on hoof load in work, with a one-page checklist for the yard.
problem: Research PDFs are long. The yard needs one page.
audience: Curious owners who want a clear brief, not a journal club.
faq: Is this veterinary advice?
No. It is a reading brief and a checklist.
Print or digital?
Both. PDF download plus a printed card.

name: Moisture Balm Refill
short: 120 ml refill for the Daily Hoof Kit. Same formula, no extra plastic kit.
problem: People repurchase a full kit when they only need balm.
audience: Kit owners on a refill cycle.
benefits: Lower cost than a new kit
faq: Fits the original pot?
Yes. Same thread.
Scent-free option?
Not in this SKU.
